name: Idle Life
author: modChad
description: Sixteen new idles for ponies standing about: a light or deep stretch (pegasi spread their wings), pawing the ground, looking round, a wing stretch and wing preen (pegasi), a magic fringe brush and magic sparkles (unicorns and alicorns), and at night dozing off and stargazing. Celestia and Luna also read a scroll, write one with a quill, take tea and check a shoe for a pebble, all in their magic; at sunrise and sunset Celestia flies up to tend the sun, and at moonrise and moonset Luna checks on the moon.
